rationales: Forestry is an established field concerned with forests, not the latest profession listed.
Farming is an established practice of cultivating crops and raising animals.
Biotechnology is the latest profession among these fields, applying biological processes and organisms in technology.
Horticulture is an established field focused on cultivating garden plants and crops.
A theory is an explanatory framework, not the recorded observations themselves.
Bioinformatics uses computational tools to analyze biological information.
Data are facts, names, dates, or values gathered from observations and experiments.
A law describes a consistently observed natural relationship, not the collected information.
Some fungi are multicellular, but algae are commonly described in this context as simple multicellular organisms.
Algae include simple multicellular forms such as filamentous algae.
Bacteria are unicellular organisms, not multicellular ones.
Plants are multicellular but are not generally described as simple multicellular organisms in this context.
Lipids are not the other principal component of ribosomes.
Ribosomes are composed of ribosomal RNA and proteins.
DNA is not a structural component of ribosomes.
Starch is a carbohydrate and is not a ribosomal component.
Filtration is a separation process and does not name cytoplasm shrinkage.
Endocytosis is the uptake of materials into a cell.
Turgor pressure is the pressure of cell contents against the cell wall, not shrinkage.
Plasmolysis is the shrinkage of cytoplasm away from the cell wall, usually in a hypertonic solution.
Glycolysis is an early stage of cellular respiration.
The Krebs cycle follows glycolysis and precedes the final respiratory stage.
The electron transport chain is the final stage of aerobic cellular respiration.
Fermentation is an alternative pathway used when oxygen is unavailable, not the final stage of aerobic respiration.
Entomology is the study of insects.
Taxonomy is the classification and naming of organisms.
Palaeontology is the study of fossils and ancient life.
Pharmacology is the study of drugs and their effects.
Flaccid describes a cell that has lost turgor, not the specific process of cytoplasm shrinking from the wall.
Plasmolysis is the shrinkage of cytoplasm away from the cell wall.
Plasmodesmata are channels connecting plant cells.
Turgor is the pressure of cell contents against the cell wall.
A community consists of populations of different species living together.
A habitat is the area or place in the environment where an organism lives.
A population is a group of organisms of the same species in an area.
The ecosphere is the global system encompassing Earth's ecosystems, not the usual term for an organism's living area.
Deductions are drawn from a hypothesis or results and are not the basic starting step.
Observations are the basic starting step of the biological method.
A hypothesis is a proposed explanation formulated after observations.
Experimentation tests a hypothesis and comes after the initial observations.
Carolus Linnaeus introduced the binomial system of naming organisms.
Ernst Haeckel contributed to biology but did not introduce binomial nomenclature.
Robert Whittaker proposed a five-kingdom classification system.
Aristotle made early contributions to biology but did not introduce binomial nomenclature.
Epidermal tissue is a plant tissue, not a connective tissue type.
Support tissues are plant tissues, not connective tissues in animals.
Adipose tissue is a connective tissue that stores fat.
Ground tissue is a plant tissue, not a connective tissue type.
Six months is longer than the usual human red blood cell lifespan.
Two months is shorter than the usual human red blood cell lifespan.
Seven months is much longer than the usual human red blood cell lifespan.
Human red blood cells typically live about 120 days, or approximately four months.
Prophase is only one stage of mitosis and does not last for most of the cell cycle.
Interphase typically occupies at least 90% of the total cell-cycle time.
Anaphase is a brief stage of mitosis.
Telophase is a brief stage of mitosis.
Amylase breaks down starch, not protein stains.
Lipase breaks down fats, not protein stains.
Protease breaks down proteins and is used to remove protein stains.
Thiamine is a vitamin, not an enzyme used for stain removal.
